_comment: The speech slot's engine and voices (BYOK: the key is read from the environment variable named here, never stored). One engine voice per speaker, so each tier has its own; `say { voice: "twin" }` picks it. Both voices below are ElevenLabs identifiers given on 2026-09-20. The station is Mother, the on-board AI the demo embodies: she reads the messages from Earth, the model's proposals, the twin's answers, the board's refusals, and the commissioning. On 2026-09-23 she was given the other voice (docs/mise-en-service.fr.md, section 17: she is the one who does not think, and it had to be heard); on 2026-09-25 Guillaume put the agent's voice back on her, so she and the agent share it again, and the twin and the factory keep the other one.
